connectBy.description:
expression describing connection of the next level in the hierarchy based on the current record
it can only be 1 or more == operator with && and no braces! also fields on the left side of the
== belong to the current record and the fields on the right side to the records in the next level
of the hierarchy

startWith.description: expression describing where to start hierarchy from

maxLevel.description: maximum level of hierarchy to traverse

siblingsOrder.description: order of siblings in the hierarchy

title:
Example of fetch with hierarchy:
Technology.fetch(FetchSpec.make({include: 'name, parent, meta.level',
hierarchy:{ connectBy: 'id==parent',
startWith: 'not(parent)' }}));
name: HierarchySpec
